task.request: The two caches in reportgen — the memo and the file cache — keep getting out of sync and every module invalidates by hand. I want one cache with an explicit TTL. Design it.
task.brief: Purpose: one cache, one place that decides validity; callers stop touching memo or file storage directly. Constraints: keep the CLI flags and the report output unchanged; the three existing tests must stay green; no new dependencies. Success: --fresh re-reads every source exactly once; a restart within the TTL serves sources from disk without a data read. Workspace: a new feature branch in the current checkout, no worktree. Ticket: RG-42. There is no existing initiative.

facts.q: Which single component decides whether a cached value is still valid?
facts.a: One cache component (ReportCache); callers no longer touch the memo or the file storage directly.

facts.q: What must stay unchanged by this work?
facts.a: The CLI flags, the report output and the three existing tests; no new dependencies.

facts.q: What does a --fresh run guarantee about source reads?
facts.a: Every source is re-read exactly once.

facts.q: What happens on a restart within the TTL?
facts.a: Sources are served from disk without reading the data files.

facts.q: How does a fresh run invalidate cached values?
facts.a: By key prefix through the cache's single invalidation entry point, not by purging two stores.
